name: aws-agent-skills
description: 410 eval-backed AWS CloudOps agent skills across 13 AWS service families and 6 task types, with committed median-of-3 skill-judge scorecards, signed USF v1 security manifests, and @skills protocol addressing. Install aws-cloudops (light router) or aws-cloudops-full (everything).

plugins.name: aws-cloudops
plugins.description: Lightweight entry point to the 410-skill AWS CloudOps library: installs the skill-catalog (13 family tables routing to every skill) and the aws-orchestrator pipeline (~300 tokens always-on). Add skills individually as needed, or install aws-cloudops-full for the complete set.

plugins.name: aws-cloudops-full
plugins.description: All 410 eval-backed AWS CloudOps skills + 388 slash commands. WARNING: ~106K tokens always-on per session — intended for dedicated AWS-working sessions or 1M-context plans. Most users should install aws-cloudops (the router) instead and add skills selectively.
